newsitem.title: EGYPT: EU Middle East envoy says peace in danger.
newsitem.headline: EU Middle East envoy says peace in danger.

text.p: The European Union's envoy to the Middle East said on Saturday the peace process was in danger and he would urge Russia to play a more active role in salvaging deadlocked talks between Israel and the Palestinians.
Miguel Angel Moratinos told reporters in Cairo that senior EU officials might hold a meeting next week to examine ways the 15-member bloc could revive the talks.

"The situation has become very dangerous," he said after talks with Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa. "The peace process must be saved. The European Union will do all it can through diplomatic channels to save the peace process."

Moratinos said he would head for Gaza on Sunday for talks with Palestinians and then to Israel. He would then go to Russia, which along with the United States is a sponsor of the Middle East peace effort launched in Madrid in 1991.
His visit to Russia would aim to "boost the Russian role at this difficult time," Moratinos said.
"We are very worried about the present situation. We must do all we can to overcome this crisis," he added.
Talks between Israel and the Palestinians have been on hold since the Jewish state broke ground on a settlement in East Jerusalem in March.

Moussa earlier met Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's spokesman Marwan Kanafani. The Palestinian official on Friday said the peace process was "clinically dead" and called on the United States to resurrect it.
